AROS m68k ROM banks bundled with Amiga64 (third_party/aros/)
=============================================================

What these files are
  aros-rom.bin and aros-ext.bin are the Amiga (m68k) Kickstart-replacement
  ROM banks of AROS, the AROS Research Operating System.  They are the
  Executable form of AROS code, redistributed UNMODIFIED, byte for byte as
  shipped by the AROS project.  Amiga64 contains no AROS source code and no
  modification of it.

  Build:     AROS nightly2 20260921, amiga-m68k boot ISO
  Archive:   https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/aros/nightly2/20260921/Binaries/AROS-20260921-amiga-m68k-boot-iso.zip
  SHA-256:   981817b3421a6ed245d0e259712bb876fd2e279930e4e5d2b4d55e1de7744b31 (the archive)
  Members:   aros-amiga-m68k.iso!boot/amiga/aros-rom.bin, aros-ext.bin; the
             archive's LICENSE and ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS (copied here unchanged)
  The SHA-256 of every file here is pinned in tools/aros/manifest.txt, and
  the amiga64 tool refuses a file that does not match.

Licence
  These files are licensed under the AROS Public License, Version 1.1
  (APL 1.1), whose full text is in LICENSE in this directory.  They are NOT
  covered by Amiga64's MIT licence (see the repository's LICENSE and NOTICE).
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS holds the third-party notices that ship with AROS.

Source code (APL 1.1 section 3.6)
  The Source Code version of this Covered Code is available under the terms
  of the APL 1.1 from the AROS project.  The exact build is the AROS nightly
  of 2026-09-21 ("nightly2 20260921"), amiga-m68k target, whose binary
  archive has the SHA-256
    981817b3421a6ed245d0e259712bb876fd2e279930e4e5d2b4d55e1de7744b31
  Its source is the AROS source tree as of that nightly:
    https://github.com/aros-development-team/AROS   (the AROS source tree)
    https://aros.sourceforge.io/                    (the AROS project)
    https://sourceforge.net/projects/aros/files/    (nightly binaries and
                                                     source snapshots)
  The AROS project rotates its nightly builds: on 2026-10-13 the 20260921
  folder was no longer listed on SourceForge.

Fetched from the archive above on 2026-09-25 (tools/aros/fetch.sh); copied
into the repository on 2026-10-13 after re-verifying every hash.
